item.title: 8 Ways to Optimize Your LinkedIn Profile | Elmhurst University Elmhurst University Blog
item.description: Are you making the most of your personal brand? If you are pursuing a graduate degree, looking for an internship or starting a job search, LinkedIn profile optimization should be your goal to increase your visibility to potential employers.

item.title: Make a Difference by Choosing a Public Health Career | Elmhurst University Elmhurst University Blog
item.description: Have you ever tried to prevent a problem from starting or stop it from happening again? That is the everyday mission of public health professionals—and according to the CDC Foundation, that mission is essential to protecting and improving the health of people and communities on a neighborhood, city, state, national and even global scale.

item.title: High-Quality Professional Development for Teachers | Elmhurst University Elmhurst University Blog
item.description: Learners inspire learners—educators who engage in professional development drive improvement in U.S. schools. Because of this, many states require yearly continuing education for teachers to maintain their professional educator licensure, and many metrics of educator evaluation attend to how individuals are contributing to their continued development as professionals.

item.title: The 10 Most-Viewed Elmhurst U. Blog Posts of 2025 | Elmhurst University Elmhurst University Blog
item.description: Before we head into the New Year, we’re taking a look back at the blogs that generated the most interest in 2025. This list includes blogs that have been written over the past few years, but just like classic holiday movies, these seem to have timeless appeal for readers. Read on to see whether any of your favorites made the list!

item.title: A Guide to Getting Financial Aid for Graduate School | Elmhurst University Elmhurst University Blog
item.description: The adage “the more you learn, the more you earn,” is borne out by data compiled by the Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS). In 2024, the BLS estimated the annual salary of the average worker with a master’s degree to be $95,680, while the average wage for those with a bachelor’s degree was about $80,326.

item.title: It’s Not Too Late to Earn Your Business Degree | Elmhurst University Elmhurst University Blog
item.description: Are you unhappy or unfulfilled in your current career? Do you want to enhance your skills and accelerate your professional growth? Perhaps you want to finish what you started before life had other ideas. No matter the reason, if you’re considering earning an adult business degree, rest assured it’s never too late to get one. In fact, right now might be an ideal time to do it.

item.title: Unleash the Power of Teacher Leadership | Elmhurst University
item.description: If you're a dedicated educator who's ever thought, "There must be a better way to do this," pursuing a master's in education can empower you with the tools and skills to influence the educational landscape well beyond a single classroom or school year.

item.title: Mastering AI Transformation Through Project Management | Elmhurst University Elmhurst University Blog
item.description: Every few years, a new wave of change sweeps through organizations with the same promise: adapt or become obsolete. In 2012, it was agile methodologies. In 2020, digital transformation. Now it is artificial intelligence. Organizations are racing to implement AI transformation initiatives, purchasing enterprise licenses, running prompt engineering workshops, and rebranding every internal process as “powered by AI."

item.title: How Supply Chain Leaders Can Tackle Last Mile Delivery Challenges | Elmhurst University Elmhurst University Blog
item.description: You order a container of protein powder online at 11:00 a.m. for tomorrow’s smoothie. You are offered delivery tomorrow morning, tomorrow evening or the next day. It feels effortless. item.title: AI Skills—Key to Career Success | Elmhurst University Elmhurst University Blog
item.description: The significance of Artificial Intelligence (AI) proficiency today is akin to the importance of internet literacy in 2005. With AI integrated into hiring processes, analytics, cybersecurity, marketing, finance and decision-making systems, proficiency in AI has become essential for college graduates. Employers prioritize candidates with skills in AI, generative AI and AI literacy.
